label: ZKN_ULMOON_010_000
text:
Its body is soft and weak. In nature, its
perpetual fate is to be seen by others as food.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_011_000
text:
Its hard shell doesn’t crack a bit even if Pikipek
pecks at it, but it will tip over, spilling out
its insides.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_012_000
text:
Nectar from pretty flowers is its favorite food.
In fields of flowers, it has heated battles with
Cutiefly for territory.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_019_000
text:
This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its
sharp incisors can easily cut right through
hard wood.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_020_000
text:
Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its
balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will
get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_021_000
text:
Due to its short wings, it can’t fly long
distances. It wanders about restlessly and
pecks at bug Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_022_000
text:
In Alola, fish Pokémon are its prey. It can be
seen circling above the ocean searching
for food.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_023_000
text:
The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food.
It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg
gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_024_000
text:
After stunning its opponents with the pattern
on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its
body and waits for them to stop moving.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_025_000
text:
While sleeping, it generates electricity in the
sacs in its cheeks. If it’s not getting enough
sleep, it will be able to use only weak electricity.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_026_000
text:
Because so many Trainers like the way Pikachu
looks, you don’t see this Pokémon very often.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_027_000
text:
When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it
heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a
lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_028_000
text:
Thanks to its thick claws, it’s good at climbing
trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park
themselves in trees and go right to sleep.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_035_000
text:
Bathed in moonlight, its wings glow faintly.
Without even flapping, Clefairy rises into the air,
where it dances around.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_036_000
text:
Some scientists believe that it gazes intently at
the sky on nights with a full moon because
it’s homesick.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_037_000
text:
It manipulates balls of fire to catch its prey.
If you raise one from when it’s young, it will
grow close to you like a puppy Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_038_000
text:
The flickering flames it spews from its mouth
leave its opponents hypnotized. Then, this
extremely intelligent Pokémon attacks.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_039_000
text:
The songs they sing are totally different
depending on the region they live in. Some even
sound like they’re shouting!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_040_000
text:
When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might,
and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they
can grow 20 times larger!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_041_000
text:
Their skin is so thin that they’ll be burned if
sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they
gather together to warm one another’s bodies.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_042_000
text:
They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in
one go. They have been known to drink so much
blood that they can no longer fly.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_046_000
text:
The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are
controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the
mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_047_000
text:
Its poisonous spores are also used in traditional
medicine. Apparently, spores produced in Alola
are not of very good quality.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_050_000
text:
Around their crops, farmers plant the kind of
tree that Diglett like to eat as a way of getting
Diglett to plow the fields for them.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_051_000
text:
Dugtrio’s heads are sleek and smooth and
incredibly hard. It can dig through any soil with
its headbutts.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_052_000
text:
It loves coins, so if you give it one, you can
make friends with Meowth easily. But it’s fickle,
so you can’t count on that friendship lasting.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_053_000
text:
This Pokémon is popular with rich people.
It’s also targeted by hunters who are after
the jewel in its forehead.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_054_000
text:
It has been found that its brain cells are
10 times more active when Psyduck is
experiencing a headache.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_055_000
text:
A professional swimmer, it can continue
swimming for two days straight by waving its
long tail skillfully.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_056_000
text:
If one gets angry, all the others around it will
get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop
of Mankey.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_057_000
text:
The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than
those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy
despite its constant raging.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_058_000
text:
It has lived alongside humans since ages ago.
Its bones have been found in excavations of
ruins from the Stone Age.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_059_000
text:
There are so many old tales about them that
they’re called legendary Pokémon, but there are
way more of them around than you’d expect.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_060_000
text:
The direction of the swirl on their stomachs
differs depending on where they live. Poliwag
aficionados can tell them apart at a glance.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_061_000
text:
Its health suffers when its skin dries out, so be
sure to moisturize it diligently.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_062_000
text:
The muscles it has developed through swimming
are thick and powerful. When it lands a square
punch, it can turn huge boulders to dust.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_063_000
text:
It can read others’ minds and will teleport away
when danger approaches. You must clear your
mind if you want to catch it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_064_000
text:
It possesses strong mental capabilities, but its
psychic powers are halved when it’s not
holding a silver spoon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_065_000
text:
If it trusts someone deeply, it will let them have
one of its spoons. Anything you eat with that
spoon is apparently delicious.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_066_000
text:
It likes food that’s highly nutritious because its
instincts drive it to build muscle efficiently.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_067_000
text:
A popular motif for sculptures, its incredibly
well-developed muscles have captured the
imagination of many an artist.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_068_000
text:
With four arms, it can attack and defend
simultaneously. It’s said to have mastered
every martial art in the world.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_072_000
text:
Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1%
contains the organ that makes its poison.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_073_000
text:
It communicates with others of its kind by
lighting up the red orbs on its head. When
the orbs are blinking, it’s a warning sign.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_074_000
text:
It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs.
People who see it in action have been known to
take up bouldering.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_075_000
text:
It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a
river, it will explode with its last gasp.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_076_000
text:
It detonates its own body. The power from
that explosion can propel it up steep mountain
paths with amazing speed.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_079_000
text:
Although their tails, which fall off naturally, can
easily be found lying around, they’re a precious
ingredient for cooking.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_080_000
text:
Shellder, in its greed to suck out more and more
sweetness from Slowbro’s tail, has
metamorphosed into a spiral-shaped shell.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_081_000
text:
Perhaps because electrical lines are often
buried these days, the number of Magnemite
attacks on power plants has increased.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_082_000
text:
When rain clouds form, many Magneton gather
in high places to wait for lightning to strike.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_086_000
text:
Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don’t bother it
at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in
warm waters.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_087_000
text:
It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise
in its body temperature helps its digestion.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_088_000
text:
The wastewater coming from factories is clean
these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat.
They’re said to be on the verge of extinction.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_089_000
text:
Because they scatter germs everywhere,
they’ve long been targeted for extermination,
leading to a steep decline in their population.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_090_000
text:
Even when its shell is closed, its tongue still
hangs out. If you give its tongue a good yank,
the shock will cause Shellder to open its shell.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_091_000
text:
Slowpoke tails are its favorite food. It has even
been known to come up on land to look for
Slowpoke from time to time.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_092_000
text:
Poisonous gas comprises 95% of its body. It’s
said that the remaining 5% is made up of the
souls of those who died from the gas.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_093_000
text:
It’s dangerous to go outside alone on nights
when you’re feeling sad. Haunter will catch you,
and you won’t be able to go back home.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_094_000
text:
Even your home isn’t safe. Gengar will lurk in
whatever dark corner of a room it can find and
wait for its chance to catch its prey.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_096_000
text:
It puts its prey to sleep and devours their
dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour,
so Drowzee doesn’t particularly like eating them.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_097_000
text:
There are some Hypno that assist doctors with
patients who can’t sleep at night in hospitals.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_102_000
text:
Although they are the same size as other
Exeggcute, the ones produced in Alola are quite
heavy. Their shells are packed full.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_103_000
text:
Each of its three heads has its own thoughts.
When they want to go in different directions,
Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_104_000
text:
It wears its mother’s skull on its head, so no
one knows what its bare face looks like.
However, it’s clear that it’s always crying.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_105_000
text:
They thump their bones rhythmically to
communicate among themselves. There are
nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_108_000
text:
It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it
licks always stinks afterward, so whether it’s
really clean is...questionable.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_113_000
text:
Because the eggs on their bellies have been
overharvested by people in the past, the
Chansey population remains very small.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_115_000
text:
You shouldn’t get close to the child when it’s
playing outside its mother’s pouch. Its mother is
always nearby watching over it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_118_000
text:
The way it swims along fluttering its dress-like
fins has earned it the name “princess of
the water.”

label: ZKN_ULMOON_119_000
text:
To attract females, males dance on the river’s
floor. The females gather around the male that
dances most gracefully.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_120_000
text:
No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its
amazing regenerative powers return it to its
previous state in half a day!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_121_000
text:
It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim
through the water. It always seems to be
sending out mysterious radio waves.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_122_000
text:
It creates invisible walls with its pantomiming.
If you don’t act impressed, it will attack you
with a double slap!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_123_000
text:
Some call it a ninja. Its movements—
imperceptibly quick—are sufficient to cleave
the air in two. It’s very popular in Alola.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_124_000
text:
Its strange cries sound like human language.
There are some musicians who compose songs
for Jynx to sing.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_125_000
text:
While it’s often blamed for power outages, the
truth is the cause of outages is more often
an error on the part of the electric company.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_126_000
text:
The hotter the place, the better they feel.
Magmar in Alola are said to be hardier than
those in other areas.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_127_000
text:
Although it’s tough, it can’t handle cold well.
When night falls, it buries itself in leafage
and sleeps.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_128_000
text:
The climate seems to be related to the reason
Tauros in Alola are a little calmer than those in
other regions.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_129_000
text:
Thanks to their strong hold on life, dirty water
doesn’t bother them at all. They live in waters
all over the world!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_130_000
text:
The energy from evolution stimulated its brain
cells strongly, causing it to become
very ferocious.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_131_000
text:
They’ve been so cherished that there’s now an
overabundance. The fish Pokémon population
has declined in waters with too many Lapras.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_132_000
text:
It transforms into whatever it sees. If the thing
it’s transforming into isn’t right in front of it,
Ditto relies on its memory—so sometimes it fails.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_133_000
text:
Its genes are easily influenced by its
surroundings. Even its face starts to look like
that of its Trainer.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_134_000
text:
It detects nearby moisture with its fin. When its
fin begins trembling rapidly, that means rain will
fall in a few hours.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_135_000
text:
Its fur stands on end, becoming like needles
it fires at enemies. Once they’re weakened, it
finishes them off with a 10,000 volt shock.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_136_000
text:
The flame chamber inside its body ignites when
Flareon gets agitated, reaching temperatures of
up to 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_137_000
text:
It was built 20 years ago by scientists who
dreamed of exploring space. Their dreams have
yet to come true.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_138_000
text:
It was restored from an ancient fossil. Those
Helix Fossils are excavated from areas that
were once oceans long, long ago.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_139_000
text:
It wraps its prey in its tentacles to immobilize
them and then finishes them off with its
sharp fangs.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_140_000
text:
This Pokémon became extinct everywhere,
except in a few areas. It protects itself with its
hard shell.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_141_000
text:
It swims at speeds of roughly 29 knots, quickly
closing in on its prey and slashing into them
with its scythes to finish them off.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_142_000
text:
It flew through the open skies over the ancient
continent as if they were its own. When it
touched ground, its walk was weak and slow.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_143_000
text:
It has no interest in anything other than eating.
Even if you climb up on its stomach while it’s
napping, it doesn’t seem to mind at all!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_147_000
text:
It sheds its skin—almost on a daily basis—and
grows larger. Its skin is soft just after it’s
been shed.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_148_000
text:
Some say that if you see it at the start of the
year, flying through the sky and twisting its
body, you’ll be healthy all year long.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_149_000
text:
You’ll often hear tales of this kindhearted
Pokémon rescuing people or Pokémon that
are drowning.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_163_000
text:
It cries out at the same time every day. A long
time ago, people cherished it and considered it
a divine messenger sent to tell the time.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_164_000
text:
When it turns its head entirely upside down,
you know it’s troubled by something. If you don’t
leave it be, it will peck you.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_165_000
text:
These very cowardly Pokémon join together and
use Reflect to protect their nest.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_166_000
text:
It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly
dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to
you, good things will happen to you.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_167_000
text:
Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that
strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that
gets caught in its web.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_168_000
text:
It spews threads from its mouth to catch its
prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go
hunt aggressively.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_169_000
text:
It feeds on the blood of living people and
Pokémon. If it can’t drink any blood for even a
short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_170_000
text:
Chinchou blink their shining antennae at one
another to claim their respective turf.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_171_000
text:
It lives far down in the depths of the ocean. It
blinds its prey with light, using the moment
they’re dazzled to swallow them whole.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_172_000
text:
It has electric sacs in its cheeks. When they’re
fully charged, Pichu plays very energetically.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_173_000
text:
Said to have ridden here on a shooting star,
Cleffa seem to appear in places where
meteorites have struck in the past.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_174_000
text:
Left to its own devices, it will constantly
practice singing. You should make it take a
break so it doesn’t hurt its throat.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_177_000
text:
The look in its eyes gives the impression that
it’s carefully observing you. If you approach it,
Natu will hop away.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_178_000
text:
While it can see the future, it has no desire to
change it, which is probably why it remains
motionless at all times.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_179_000
text:
Rubbing its fleece generates electricity.
You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you
use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_180_000
text:
It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it
stores up too much, it will start to go bald in
those patches.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_181_000
text:
Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been
prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_185_000
text:
The result of its holding the same pose all the
time is arms that have become supple
yet strong.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_186_000
text:
The longer and more luxurious the curled hair on
its head, the greater the number of Poliwag and
Poliwhirl that will obey it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_190_000
text:
It searches for prey from the tops of trees.
When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet,
Aipom gets excited and pounces.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_196_000
text:
Psychic power builds up in the orb on its
forehead as it bathes in the sunshine. Espeon is
not good at battling at night.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_197_000
text:
It lurks in the dark of night looking for prey.
At the moment it pounces, the rings on its
body glow dimly but ominously.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_198_000
text:
It searches for shiny things for its boss.
Murkrow’s presence is said to be unlucky, so
many people detest it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_199_000
text:
It’s called “the sage of the sea.” It engages in
battles of wits with Oranguru, but the result is
usually a draw.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_200_000
text:
What makes it happy is imitating the voices of
weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn’t
deal well with folks who aren’t easily frightened.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_204_000
text:
It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva,
making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco
are ridiculously huge.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_205_000
text:
In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the
inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day,
no one has ever seen that sight.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_206_000
text:
When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail
to make its escape. If you happen to find one,
consider yourself lucky.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_209_000
text:
In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite
timid. When playing with other puppy
Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_210_000
text:
Although it’s popular with young people,
Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally
incompetent as a watchdog.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_212_000
text:
Once it has identified something as an enemy, it
will continue beating them with its steel-hard
pincers until there’s nothing left but scraps.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_214_000
text:
It roams through forests searching for sweet
nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical
strength, it’s not that good at flying.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_215_000
text:
It blends into the dark of night to ambush its
prey. Sneasel will attack Sandshrew, but its
hard skin can cause Sneasel’s claws to snap off.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_222_000
text:
In Alola, where their natural enemies Mareanie
are plentiful, many Corsola have stubby
branches on their heads.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_223_000
text:
Also known as the “sniper of the seas,”
its water gun can hit prey without fail from
over 300 feet away.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_224_000
text:
It usually sleeps in caves. The pitch-black ink
that Octillery spits is also used for cooking.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_225_000
text:
It wraps food in its tail to carry it around.
The Delibird with the biggest tail is the boss
of the flock!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_226_000
text:
Many people have taken up surfing because
they admire how magnificently Mantine swims.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_227_000
text:
Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy,
but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles
an hour!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_228_000
text:
They make repeated eerie howls before dawn
to call attention to their pack.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_229_000
text:
Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long
time ago thought it was the grim reaper and
feared it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_233_000
text:
Even though it doesn’t die in the vacuum of
space, it can’t move around very well in
zero gravity.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_235_000
text:
It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from
the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol,
Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_238_000
text:
Highly perceptive sensors, Smoochum’s lips are
kept moist by its daily application of tree sap.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_239_000
text:
When its horns shine a bluish white, that’s the
sign it’s fully charged. You’ll get a shocking
jolt if you touch it!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_240_000
text:
Its body temperature is always around 1,100
degrees Fahrenheit. If Magby falls into a small-
enough pond, the whole thing will dry up.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_241_000
text:
Its milk is delicious and chock-full of nutrients.
However, if you drink too much, it could make
your stomach hurt, so be careful.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_242_000
text:
This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only
Chansey that share a strong bond with their
Trainer can evolve, so people say.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_246_000
text:
Raised on nutrients it finds in the dirt, it eats
roughly a mountain’s worth of dirt before
it becomes a pupa.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_247_000
text:
This dangerous pupa thrashes about. Its shell is
as hard as bedrock, containing its gradually
forming new body within.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_248_000
text:
This Pokémon is a mobile disaster, leaving
mountains crumbled and houses destroyed in
its wake.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_278_000
text:
It builds nests in cliffs by the sea. It circles the
skies above the ocean looking for its favorite
food—Wishiwashi.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_279_000
text:
It scoops up Wishiwashi in its huge beak and
swallows them whole. It can devour more than
30 at one go!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_283_000
text:
It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots
of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider,
whose habitat and diet are similar.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_284_000
text:
Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent.
It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_296_000
text:
There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew
that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_297_000
text:
Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily
strong. There are some small ones that move
nimbly and use moves skillfully.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_299_000
text:
It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in
its prey with powerful magnetism. But
sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_302_000
text:
Materials from gems it has eaten float to the
surface of its body and can form an infinite
number of patterns among individuals.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_303_000
text:
It has two mouths. The big jaws on the back of
its head can’t taste anything, so that’s the
mouth it uses to eat foods it doesn’t like.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_309_000
text:
Static electricity builds up all over its body
as strands of its long fur rub together. This
Pokémon boasts incredible speed.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_310_000
text:
It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so
it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with
electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_318_000
text:
With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily
chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with
Basculin over food.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_319_000
text:
It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to
propel itself. It’s very sensitive to the scent
of blood.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_320_000
text:
Due to their memories of when they once lived
on land, pods of them will, very rarely, wash up
on shore.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_321_000
text:
When a small Wailmer is attacked by Sharpedo
or Dhelmise, its whole pod works together to
protect it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_324_000
text:
It burns coal to produce energy. When it has
burned through all of its coal, it becomes unable
to move.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_327_000
text:
Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its
stumbling movements, it evades opponents’
attacks brilliantly!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_328_000
text:
It builds nests that double as traps, lying in
wait for its prey to get caught. When night falls,
it digs itself a spot beneath the sand to sleep.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_329_000
text:
It vibrates its wings to send out odd sound
waves. Trainers who are with it need earplugs.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_330_000
text:
People continue to have their hearts stolen by
its enchanting songs and find themselves
stranded in the desert.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_339_000
text:
Its whiskers are filled with nerves. They can
sense smells and flavors just as a person’s nose
or tongue would.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_340_000
text:
Its vision is not that good. It senses vibrations in
the water with its whiskers to determine the
location of its prey.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_341_000
text:
It can adapt very well to its environment.
Feebas and Corphish are about the only
Pokémon to live in stagnant ditches.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_342_000
text:
Its pincers often fall off. Unlike with Crabrawler
or Clauncher, the meat in its claws is utterly
nasty and stinking.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_343_000
text:
When they find others of their kind, they cry
out loudly and gather together. Large numbers
of them can be found in old graveyards.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_344_000
text:
The ancient people who made it apparently
modeled it after something that descended
from the sky. It fires beams from both arms.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_345_000
text:
It sticks to rocks with its powerful suckers and
can’t be washed away no matter how rough the
surf gets.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_346_000
text:
This carnivorous Pokémon lived in primordial
seas. It catches prey in its eight tentacles and
dissolves them with digestive fluid as it eats.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_347_000
text:
This is one kind of primeval bug Pokémon.
With eight wings, it could apparently swim
a lot faster than you’d expect.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_348_000
text:
Armaldo adapted from living in water to living on
land. It has been determined that it is the
ancestor of some bug Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_349_000
text:
Because of its wretched appearance, most
people pay it no attention, but there are some
who collect Feebas—and Feebas alone!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_350_000
text:
Its dwelling place is the bottom of big lakes.
Those who behold its loveliness are said to
have their hearts purified.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_351_000
text:
Its form changes depending on the weather.
The rougher conditions get, the rougher
Castform’s disposition!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_352_000
text:
Its color changes for concealment and also
when its mood or health changes. The darker
the color, the healthier it is.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_353_000
text:
There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house
where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

label: ZKN_ULMOON_354_000
text:
Resentment at being cast off made it spring into
being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy
it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_357_000
text:
Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck.
In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_359_000
text:
The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and
detest it, but interest in its power to predict
disasters is on the rise.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_361_000
text:
Rich people from cold areas all share childhood
memories of playing with Snorunt.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_362_000
text:
Its actual body is a rock that isn’t particularly
hard. Glalie absorbs moisture from the air and
drapes itself in an armor of ice.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_366_000
text:
Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious.
They can be more than 10 times as costly
as Shellder’s pearls.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_367_000
text:
Deep seas are their habitat. According to
tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore,
something unfortunate will happen.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_368_000
text:
It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The
leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it
becomes food for other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_369_000
text:
The reason it hasn’t changed at all in a hundred
million years is that it’s apparently already a
perfect life-form.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_370_000
text:
Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm
seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space
between Corsola’s branches.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_371_000
text:
Some theories suggest that its behavior
of forcefully bashing its head into things
stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_372_000
text:
Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut
up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will
be able to fly.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_373_000
text:
Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its
body finally mutated, and at last it has its
heart’s desire—wings.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_374_000
text:
If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It
will also burst out strong magnetism, causing
nearby machines to break.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_375_000
text:
It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it
finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its
sharp claws and never lets go.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_376_000
text:
It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy
than a supercomputer, which enables it to
calmly back them into a corner.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_408_000
text:
Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It
snapped trees by headbutting them, and then
it fed on their ripe berries.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_409_000
text:
This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully.
Its brain was really small, so some theories
suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_410_000
text:
Although its fossils can be found in layers of
primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever
been discovered.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_411_000
text:
This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years
ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder
than steel.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_422_000
text:
When it senses danger, a purple liquid oozes out
of it. The liquid is thought to be something like
greasy sweat.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_423_000
text:
Their shape and color change, depending on
their environment and diet. There are many of
them at beaches where the waves are calm.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_424_000
text:
It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both
of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze,
that’s proof it really likes you.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_425_000
text:
Wandering souls gathered together to form this
Pokémon. When trying to make friends with
children, Drifloon grabs them by the hand.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_426_000
text:
The raw material for the gas inside its body
is souls. When its body starts to deflate, it’s
thought to carry away people and Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_427_000
text:
The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it
can launch a swift counterattack if it’s attacked
by an enemy.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_428_000
text:
It’s notably wary and has a dislike of fighting,
but at the same time, it can deliver powerful
kicks with its lithe legs.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_429_000
text:
Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches
or terrifying visions that torment others.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_430_000
text:
Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it.
The only time it dirties its own hands is in
delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_438_000
text:
If its body gets too damp, it will die. So, in a
process reminiscent of sweating, its eyes
expel moisture.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_439_000
text:
When this gifted mimic surprises an opponent,
Mime Jr. feels so happy that it ends up
forgetting it was imitating something.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_440_000
text:
When it sees something round and white,
Happiny puts it into the pouch on its stomach. It
sometimes becomes overloaded and can’t move.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_443_000
text:
Its original home is an area much hotter than
Alola. If you’re planning to live with one, your
heating bill will soar.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_444_000
text:
It sheds its skin and gradually grows larger. Its
scales can be ground into a powder and used
as raw materials for traditional medicine.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_445_000
text:
Its fine scales don’t just reduce wind
resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury
to any opponent who attacks it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_446_000
text:
Anything that looks edible, Munchlax will go on
and swallow whole. Its stomach is tough enough
to handle it even if the food has gone rotten.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_447_000
text:
It uses waves called auras to communicate with
others of its kind. It doesn’t make any noise
during this time, so its enemies can’t detect it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_448_000
text:
Lucario reads its opponent’s feelings with its
aura waves. It finds out things it would rather
not know, so it gets stressed out easily.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_456_000
text:
It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays
near the surface during the day and moves to
the depths when night falls.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_457_000
text:
They traverse the deep waters as if crawling
over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its
fins shine like stars in the night sky.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_458_000
text:
Mantyke are friendly toward people and will
approach boats closely. The patterns on their
backs differ depending on their habitat.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_461_000
text:
Thanks to its increased intelligence, scrapping
over food is a thing of the past. A scratch from
its claws will give you a case of frostbite!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_462_000
text:
There are still people who believe that this
Pokémon came from outer space. It emanates
a powerful magnetic field.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_463_000
text:
It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its
hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a
single small bean with its tongue.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_466_000
text:
A single Electivire can provide enough electricity
for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_467_000
text:
Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting
fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp.
It avoids this method when hunting prey.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_470_000
text:
It gets its nutrition from photosynthesis. It lives
a quiet life deep in forests where clean
rivers flow.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_471_000
text:
It can instantaneously freeze any moisture
that’s around it, creating ice pellets to shoot at
its prey.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_474_000
text:
A faulty update was added to its programming.
Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the
experiment may have been a failure.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_476_000
text:
It uses three small units to catch prey and
battle enemies. The main body mostly just
gives orders.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_478_000
text:
It’s said that on nights of terrible blizzards, it
comes down to human settlements. If you hear
it knocking at your door, do not open it!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_506_000
text:
This Pokémon is popular with beginners
because it’s intelligent, obedient to its Trainer’s
commands, and easy to raise.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_507_000
text:
It has been living with people for so long that
portrayals of it can be found on the walls of
caves from long, long ago.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_508_000
text:
Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold
regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_524_000
text:
It was found in a fissure in a layer of exposed
rock. The material that makes up its body is
dirt from several hundred years ago.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_525_000
text:
Its orange crystals are lumps of powerful
energy. They’re valuable, so Boldore is
sometimes targeted for them.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_526_000
text:
It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out
energy. It’s usually lurking deep beneath
the surface.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_546_000
text:
When attacked, it expels cotton from its
body to create a diversion. The cotton it loses
grows back in quickly.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_547_000
text:
Whimsicott doesn’t live in a fixed location. It
floats around on whirling winds, appearing all
over the place to perform its mischief.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_548_000
text:
They prefer clean water and soil. When the
environment they live in turns bad, the whole
bunch will up and move to a new area.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_549_000
text:
It’s well liked by other Pokémon because of its
beauty. The flower on its head needs constant
care, or it will soon wither and rot.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_550_000
text:
When a school of Basculin appears in a lake,
everything else disappears, except for Corphish
and Crawdaunt. That’s how violent Basculin are.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_551_000
text:
Sandile’s still not good at hunting, so it mostly
eats things that have collapsed in the desert.
It’s called “the cleaner of the desert.”

label: ZKN_ULMOON_552_000
text:
It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as
emergency meals when its hunts
are unsuccessful.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_553_000
text:
It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon
whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_559_000
text:
It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to
protect itself. The saggier their skin, the more
respect they garner.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_560_000
text:
It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a
certain territory that it never leaves its whole
life long.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_564_000
text:
Its hunting grounds encompassed a broad area,
from the land to more than half a mile deep in
the ocean.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_565_000
text:
Carracosta eats every last bit of the prey it
catches, even the shells and bones, to further
strengthen its sturdy shell.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_566_000
text:
Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird
Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_567_000
text:
Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the
muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak,
so it needs a long runway in order to take off.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_568_000
text:
If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the
toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be
a life-threatening situation.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_569_000
text:
Some say the reason Garbodor in Alola are a
little stronger than their counterparts elsewhere
is the presence of Muk, their natural enemy.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_570_000
text:
If a normally talkative child suddenly stops
talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_571_000
text:
If it thinks humans are going to discover its den,
Zoroark shows them visions that make them
wander around in the woods.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_572_000
text:
When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning
or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a
whole day washing its tail in clean spring water.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_573_000
text:
The oil that seeps from its body is really
smooth. For people troubled by bad skin,
this oil is an effective treatment.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_582_000
text:
When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not
to melt, and thus Vanillite was born. At night, it
buries itself in snow to sleep.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_583_000
text:
This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age.
It’s incredibly popular in very hot regions.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_584_000
text:
Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted
by the day’s light, stick to each other and
freeze together in the cold return of night.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_587_000
text:
As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird
Pokémon keep their distance. That’s why
Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_592_000
text:
Using the invisible poison spikes on its veillike
arms and legs, it paralyzes its enemies and
causes them to drown.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_593_000
text:
Fishermen are terrified of Jellicent.
It’s rumored to drag them into the sea
and steal their lives away.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_594_000
text:
The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened
condition is that any Pokémon coming after
them may also attack Alomomola.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_605_000
text:
This Pokémon is shrouded in mystery. It’s said
to have appeared from a UFO that fell from the
sky about 50 years ago.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_606_000
text:
It has strong psychic powers. Using its fingers
that flash three different colors, it controls its
opponents and rewrites their memories.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_619_000
text:
They seclude themselves in the mountains and
devote themselves to training. The form of their
kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_620_000
text:
When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you’re in
danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to
see is about to be unleashed!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_621_000
text:
It infiltrates tunnels that Pokémon like Diglett
and Dugtrio have dug and quietly waits for prey
to pass through.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_622_000
text:
Although ancient people apparently built it by
working with clay, the source of its energy
is unclear.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_623_000
text:
When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages
indiscriminately, turning the whole town around
it into a mountain of rubble.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_624_000
text:
It follows Bisharp’s orders to a tee when it
attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent,
Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_625_000
text:
It leads a group of Pawniard. Bisharp doesn’t
even change its expression when it deals
the finishing blow to an opponent.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_627_000
text:
Known as a natural-born warrior, soon after its
hatching, it will challenge its parent to a fight in
order to gain their acceptance.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_628_000
text:
Known as “the hero of the skies,” this
Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will
never retreat, even when it’s injured.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_629_000
text:
Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth
spurts. It often has to replace the bones it
wears as its size increases.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_630_000
text:
It’s always searching for food for Vullaby. When
it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it
right off to its nest.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_636_000
text:
It protects itself with flame. Long years ago,
people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_637_000
text:
According to legends, it was hatched from a
flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon
that were suffering from the cold.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_661_000
text:
Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in
cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_662_000
text:
Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in
the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_663_000
text:
Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet.
It approaches at high speeds and smacks them
down to the ground with its powerful kick.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_667_000
text:
This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with
curiosity. When it gets angry or starts
fighting, its short mane gets hot.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_668_000
text:
The temperature of its breath is over 10,000
degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on
its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_669_000
text:
Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s
collected from its flower. The crown has hidden
healing properties.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_670_000
text:
It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its
heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives
anyone who messes up a flower bed.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_671_000
text:
Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said
to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_674_000
text:
It’s desperate to intimidate its opponents.
Be nice and pretend to be scared if you
catch it glaring at you intensely.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_675_000
text:
Pangoro is the type to talk with its fists. It
doesn’t say much as it pummels opponents with
enough force to send a dump truck flying.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_676_000
text:
Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer,
but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_686_000
text:
When exchanging information with others of its
kind, it flashes the light-emitting spots on its
body in a complex rhythm.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_687_000
text:
It flashes the pattern on its torso to control its
prey and draw them in. The edges of its fins are
supremely sharp.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_690_000
text:
It’s not good at swimming, so it clings to the
seaweed. In the Alola region, it’s often found
near Dhelmise.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_691_000
text:
It blends in with seaweed to ambush its prey
and then takes them down with a poisonous
liquid strong enough to melt metal.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_692_000
text:
It moves around by jetting water from its right
pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it’s
terrible at swimming straight.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_693_000
text:
Its right arm is packed with meat. When its
pincer falls off, it’s exported to be used as a
cooking ingredient.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_696_000
text:
Tyrunt is spoiled and selfish. It may just be
trying to frolic, but sometimes the ones it’s
trying to frolic with are gravely injured.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_697_000
text:
The king of the ancient world, it can easily
crunch a car with the devastating strength
of its enormous jaws.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_698_000
text:
Amaura was restored successfully, but it’s not
expected to live long because of the heat of the
current environment.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_699_000
text:
This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a
surface temperature of around
–240 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_700_000
text:
Sylveon wraps its ribbonlike feelers around its
Trainer’s arm because this touch enables it to
read its Trainer’s feelings.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_701_000
text:
In combat, Hawlucha leaps nimbly about, taking
advantage of its opponents’ blind spots. It’s
also skilled at using superb submission holds.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_702_000
text:
Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its
surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs
that shoot electricity.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_703_000
text:
To keep the jewels on their bodies free of
tarnish, packs of Carbink use their soft manes
to polish one another’s jewels.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_704_000
text:
Its body is mostly water. If it dries out, it will
die, so it’s always sitting with perfect stillness
in the shade.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_705_000
text:
Its entire body is covered with gooey mucus
that can dissolve anything. Be sure to put
gloves on if you’re going to touch it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_706_000
text:
Underneath its slimy skin is a thick layer of fat,
and the combination of the two makes enemies’
attacks slide right off.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_707_000
text:
Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals
that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki
began appearing in human settlements.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_708_000
text:
An unknown spirit came to lodge in a tree
stump, creating this Pokémon. A cure-all can be
made from an infusion of its green leaves.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_709_000
text:
This Pokémon controls trees via roots
stretching from its feet, and it will attack
anyone that dares to ravage the forest.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_714_000
text:
It flies around in search of fruit to eat. It uses
ultrasonic waves to detect which fruits are ripe.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_715_000
text:
This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks anything it
sees with ultrasonic waves that can
crush boulders.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_718_000
text:
Some say it can change to an even more
powerful form when battling those who threaten
the ecosystem.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_722_000
text:
It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has
been known to use its Trainer’s pocket or bag
as a nest.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_723_000
text:
Supremely sensitive to the presence of others,
it can detect opponents standing behind it,
flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_724_000
text:
Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an
enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are
decided in the blink of an eye.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_725_000
text:
Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time
comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and
burns away the old fur.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_726_000
text:
When its mane is standing on end, you can tell
it’s feeling good. When it isn’t feeling well, its fur
will lie down flat.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_727_000
text:
When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames
around its waist become especially intense.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_728_000
text:
Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons
to jump higher. It’s quite the acrobatic fighter!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_729_000
text:
It attacks by smacking its enemies with the
exploding water balloons that it creates.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_730_000
text:
Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical
look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony
in song.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_731_000
text:
It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are
heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times
per second!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_732_000
text:
From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries
it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise
to new plants.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_733_000
text:
Known for forming harmonious couples, this
Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a
good luck charm.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_734_000
text:
Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh
living things, so it marches down streets
in search of prey.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_735_000
text:
Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of
itself and pounces when it spots its favorite
meal—Rattata!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_736_000
text:
It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in
their tracks, and then it grabs them in its
sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_737_000
text:
Its stout shell provides excellent defense from
attacks. It uses electricity on
persistent opponents.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_738_000
text:
Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic
flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for
it to deliver an electric beam attack.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_739_000
text:
Crabrawler has been known to mistake
Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The
enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_740_000
text:
Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling.
There are records of its turning back
avalanches with a flurry of punches.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_741_000
text:
This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer
gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon
becomes fiercely angry.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_742_000
text:
Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It
skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes’
movements and make fools of them.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_743_000
text:
It can predict the weather from moisture levels
and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself
when there are a few clear days in a row.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_744_000
text:
When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you,
that’s proof of its love for you. However, the
rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_745_000
text:
The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife.
Fragments that break off are treasured as
good luck charms.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_746_000
text:
When it’s in a jam, its shining eyes attract
others of its kind. The light from its eyes is
visible almost 25 miles away.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_747_000
text:
Aside from its head, its body parts
regenerate quickly if they’re cut off. After a
good night’s sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_748_000
text:
With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter
within. The flow of the tides doesn’t affect
Toxapex in there, so it’s very comfortable.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_749_000
text:
Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be
loaded with 50 times its own body weight
and will be totally fine.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_750_000
text:
It can trudge mountain roads without rest
for three days and three nights, all the while
dragging a 10-ton load.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_751_000
text:
It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in
water, so it wears a water bubble on its head
when it walks around on land.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_752_000
text:
It has a habit of storing things it values in its
water bubble. If its Trainer doesn’t watch out,
Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_753_000
text:
It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the
sunlight regularly, it grows up with
vivid coloration.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_754_000
text:
As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it’s
dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some
to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_755_000
text:
It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the
spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_756_000
text:
When it starts fighting for territory with
Parasect, the entire area gets completely
coated in spores!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_757_000
text:
It weakens opponents and sends them
reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn’t
deal well with Spinda, since it’s always reeling.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_758_000
text:
It punishes Salandit that couldn’t bring it food
with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_759_000
text:
Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any
way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with
amazing power.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_760_000
text:
It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many
people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in
the Alola region.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_761_000
text:
It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird
Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head.
It’s usually a fruitless attempt.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_762_000
text:
It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its
head with abandon. They’re quite painful when
they smack you!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_763_000
text:
A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and
a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it
kicks an opponent.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_764_000
text:
It picks flowers and sticks them to its body
with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts
from its petals has a healing effect.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_765_000
text:
Oranguru don’t get along with each other, so
they’re always engaging in battles of wits to
decide which one is superior.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_766_000
text:
Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of
its diet. The one that can throw a berry the
farthest is the boss of the troop.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_767_000
text:
An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, Wimpod
will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if
anything comes near it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_768_000
text:
Its claws, which it can extend and retract at
will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is
sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_769_000
text:
If you build sand mounds when you’re playing,
destroy them before you go home, or they
may get possessed and become Sandygast.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_770_000
text:
Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt
its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying
Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_771_000
text:
Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you
accidentally step on one, you’ll slip, and it will
get mad and smack you!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_772_000
text:
There’s danger of its going on a rampage, so its
true power is sealed away beneath its
control mask.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_773_000
text:
Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its
will was strengthened, and it was able to
destroy its control mask.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_774_000
text:
Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable,
the shock of falling to the ground smashes the
shell to smithereens.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_775_000
text:
It remains asleep from birth to death as a result
of the sedative properties of the leaves that
form its diet.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_776_000
text:
Its exploding shell poses a real danger but
is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days,
Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_777_000
text:
Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat
limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning
strike it!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_778_000
text:
A gust of wind revealed what hides under this
Pokémon’s rag to a passing Trainer, who went
home and died painfully that very night.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_779_000
text:
Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s
spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches
up the spikes and eats them.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_780_000
text:
It appears in towns and plays with the children.
Drampa will protect kids when they’re in danger,
so their moms don’t have to worry.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_781_000
text:
Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch
outward for hundreds of yards. For some
reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_782_000
text:
It will never show an enemy its back in battle.
Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant
disposition and made it one of their own.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_783_000
text:
The scales it sheds can be molded and
processed to make pots and pans. They
conduct heat well, so they’re a popular item.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_784_000
text:
It battles valiantly with its fists, which are
armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes
in uppercuts.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_785_000
text:
The lightning-wielding guardian deity of
Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity
and appears before people from time to time.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_786_000
text:
Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is
devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and
can be described as nature incarnate.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_787_000
text:
It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others
know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts.
This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_788_000
text:
Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible
calamities sometimes befall those who
recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_789_000
text:
Whether or not it’s a Pokémon from this world
is a mystery. When it’s in a jam, it warps away
to a safe place to hide.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_790_000
text:
As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow.
Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_791_000
text:
In writings from the distant past, it’s called by
the name “the beast that devours the sun.”

label: ZKN_ULMOON_792_000
text:
It sometimes summons unknown powers and
life-forms here to this world from holes that
lead to other worlds.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_793_000
text:
It appeared in this world from an Ultra
Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite
that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_794_000
text:
Buzzwole goes around showing off its
abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind
of Ultra Beast.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_795_000
text:
Although it’s alien to this world and a danger
here, it’s apparently a common organism in the
world where it normally lives.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_796_000
text:
They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of
them stand unmoving, like trees, with their
arms and legs stuck into the ground.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_797_000
text:
Although it’s alien to this world and a danger
here, it’s apparently a common organism in the
world where it normally lives.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_798_000
text:
Although it’s alien to this world and a danger
here, it’s apparently a common organism in the
world where it normally lives.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_799_000
text:
An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be
constantly hungry—it is certainly always
devouring something.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_800_000
text:
Light is the source of its energy. If it isn’t
devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it,
and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_801_000
text:
Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist,
the part called the Soul-Heart is the
actual life-form.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_802_000
text:
It sinks into the shadows of people and
Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings
and copy their capabilities.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_803_000
text:
An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it
cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with
poison from the needles on its head.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_804_000
text:
One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing,
venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid
is also immensely adhesive.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_805_000
text:
When stone walls started moving and attacking,
the brute’s true identity was this mysterious
life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_806_000
text:
A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it
causes explosions, then takes advantage of
opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_807_000
text:
It approaches its enemies at the speed of
lightning, then tears them limb from limb with
its sharp claws.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_019_001
text:
Night after night, they sneak into people’s
homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of
them has become an issue of public concern.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_020_001
text:
It commands a nest of Rattata. Different nests
don’t get along, whipping up severe fights over
feeding grounds.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_025_001
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap. Since
the cap’s not the right size, the fit is a bit loose.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_025_007

label: ZKN_ULMOON_026_001
text:
When you rub its cheeks, a sweet fragrance
comes wafting out. However, you’ll also get a
light shock!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_027_001
text:
The skin on its back is as hard as steel.
Predators go after its soft belly, so it clings to
the ground desperately.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_028_001
text:
A long, long time ago, it lived in the desert. With
its sharp claws fully extended, it can climb right
up an iceberg without slipping.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_037_001
text:
They live together in a skulk, helping one
another. Before eating their prey, they freeze it
solid with their –58 degree Fahrenheit breath.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_038_001
text:
Some said that deities visited mountains where
Ninetales live, so in times long past, no one was
allowed to go into those mountains.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_050_001
text:
The need to dig through volcanic rock in the
ground has made them more powerful than
the Diglett of other regions.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_051_001
text:
Its shining gold whiskers are advanced
sensors that can detect vibrations from sounds
several miles away.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_052_001
text:
A royal house that flourished in the distant past
brought it here from another region. Meowth is
both selfish and prideful.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_053_001
text:
Its round face is a symbol of wealth. Persian
that have bigger, plumper faces are considered
more beautiful.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_065_001
text:
Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam’s
true power has been unleashed. With its
psychic powers, it can foresee all things.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_074_001
text:
Geodude compete against each other with
headbutts. The iron sand on their heads will
stick to whichever one has stronger magnetism.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_075_001
text:
Graveler’s entire body is tinged with electricity
due to the stones it likes to eat. It’s very
quick-tempered.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_076_001
text:
It shoots large rocks that are charged with
electricity. Tremendous electric shocks are
flung out across the whole area of impact.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_080_001
text:
Having been swallowed whole by Shellder,
Slowbro now has an iron defense. It’s pretty
comfortable in there, too.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_088_001
text:
Brought to Alola to solve the garbage problem,
Grimer seems to relish any and all kinds
of trash.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_089_001
text:
What look like fangs and claws are actually
crystallized poison that will afflict you at a
mere touch, so don’t get too close.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_094_001
text:
Mega Evolution has made it possible for Gengar
to access other dimensions. Its entire body is
brimming with strange power.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_103_001
text:
It swings its long neck like a whip and smacks
its opponents. This makes Exeggutor itself
dizzy, too.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_105_001
text:
When it beats opponents with its bone, the
cursed flames spread to them. No amount of
water will stop those flames from burning.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_115_001
text:
When the mother sees the back of her Mega-
Evolved child, it makes her think of the day
when her child will inevitably leave her.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_127_001
text:
It zips around at blistering speeds, looking for
an opening to skewer its opponent on its
giant pincers.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_130_001
text:
It zooms out of the water at Mach speeds. Even
large ships caught in its path are split cleanly
in two!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_142_001
text:
Mega Evolution awakened some dormant genes,
bringing back the sharp rocks that once
covered Aerodactyl’s entire body.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_181_001
text:
Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated
Ampharos’s cells, apparently awakening its
long-sleeping dragon’s blood.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_212_001
text:
It’s better at beating things than grasping them.
When it battles for a long time, the weight of its
pincers becomes too much to bear.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_214_001
text:
A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but
when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is
bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_229_001
text:
Houndoom’s entire body generates heat when
it Mega Evolves. Its fearsome fiery breath turns
its opponents to ash.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_248_001
text:
The effects of Mega Evolution make it more
ferocious than ever. It’s unclear whether
it can even hear its Trainer’s orders.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_302_001
text:
It blocks any and all attacks with its giant-sized
gemstone. However, the stone’s a heavy burden,
and it limits Mega Sableye’s movements.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_303_001
text:
Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if
they each had a will of their own. One gnash
from them can turn a boulder to dust.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_310_001
text:
Too much electricity has built up in its body,
irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal
to that of a lightning bolt.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_319_001
text:
The moment it charges into its opponent,
sharp spikes pop out of Sharpedo’s head,
leaving its opponent with deep wounds.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_351_001
text:
Castform changes to this form when it basks in
bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin,
it feels all dried out!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_351_002
text:
This is Castform’s form when pelted by rain. In
an experiment where it was placed in a shower,
this Pokémon didn’t change to this form.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_351_003
text:
This is Castform’s form when caught in a
hailstorm. Its whole body is chilled, and its skin
is partially frozen!

label: ZKN_ULMOON_354_001
text:
Mega Evolution increases its vindictiveness, and
the cursing power that was held back by its
zipper comes spilling out.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_359_001
text:
It converts the energy from Mega Evolution into
an intimidating aura. Fainthearted people expire
from shock at the sight of it.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_362_001
text:
The power of Mega Evolution was so strong that
it smashed Glalie’s jaw. Its inability to eat very
well leaves Glalie irritated.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_373_001
text:
It puts its forelegs inside its shell to streamline
itself for flight. Salamence flies at high speeds
over all kinds of topographical features.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_376_001
text:
When it knows it can’t win, it digs the claws
on its legs into its opponent and starts the
countdown to a big explosion.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_422_001
text:
Scientists interested in its great regenerative
capabilities are currently analyzing the materials
from which its cells are made.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_423_001
text:
A relative of Shellder and Cloyster, this
ocean dweller sometimes comes onto land
in search of food.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_428_001
text:
Mega Evolution awakens its combative instincts.
It has shed any fur that got in the way of
its attacks.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_445_001
text:
Its disposition is more vicious than before its
Mega Evolution. Garchomp carves its opponents
up with the scythes on both arms.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_448_001
text:
Bathed in explosive energy, its combative
instincts have awakened. For its enemies, it has
no mercy whatsoever.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_550_001
text:
Some people call it “the thug of the lake.”
Whether the differences in color are meaningful
is not yet known.

label: ZKN_ULMOON_669_001
text:
Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s
collected from its flower. The crown has hidden
healing properties.
